result.title: Not Every Rollout Needs Distillation: Correctness-Filtered On-Policy Self-Distillation
result.summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) supervises student-generated trajectories with a reference-conditioned version of the same base model. We ask whether every trajectory supplies distinct supervision that warrants its distillation cost. Gradient measurements on Qwen3-1.7B at initialization reveal that correct and incorrect responses have similar individual gradient magnitudes, but incorrect responses have approximately three times the coherent gradient share. Their estimated population-mean directions also largely overlap. A signal--noise model fitted at a small group size tracks alignment at larger group sizes without refitting. Motivated by these measurements, we introduce correctness-filtered OPSD (C-OPSD), which generates one response per problem and distills only a subset of incorrect responses. Removing unselected rows before both distillation forwards avoids their teacher/student forward and student backward work. Across Qwen3-1.7B, 4B, and 8B on AIME24, AIME25, and HMMT25, C-OPSD achieves on-par performance with full OPSD. In a measured micro-batch-size-four implementation, executed rows decrease by approximately 68%, and with retained rows packed into full micro-batches, training takes about 40% less time while rollout generation remains unchanged. Together, the measurements and training results connect outcome-conditioned supervision redundancy to more compute-efficient distillation.

AI.brief_summary: 论文追问 on-policy self-distillation 中每条 rollout 是否都提供值得其蒸馏开销的独特监督：在 Qwen3-1.7B 初始化时测量发现正确与错误响应的单样本梯度幅度相近，但错误响应的「相干梯度」占比约高三倍，且两者估计的总体均值方向大体重叠；据此提出 correctness-filtered OPSD，每题只采样一条响应并仅蒸馏部分错误响应，跳过未选中行以省去前后向计算，在 1.7B/4B/8B 与 AIME、HMMT 上性能与完整 OPSD 相当，训练时间约降四成。
AI.relevance_reason: 其以梯度相干性判别轨迹监督冗余、按正确性筛选训练轨迹的做法，可能为 LVR 中 latent/推理轨迹的监督选择与贡献分配提供具体筛选线索，但该工作纯文本、无视觉状态，能否迁移到多模态推理轨迹尚待核查。
